summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of the cipher-box project — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code with no behavior changes — using the GSD workflow (research → plan → verify → execute).
summary.outcome: Planning fully completed and verified (6 plans across 5 waves, all 7 scope items covered, 0 blockers). Execution reached Wave 1 complete (plans 45-01 and 45-02 landed) and Wave 2 (plan 45-03) was in progress when the transcript ended.

repo: The FUSE crate is named `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`; cargo commands must use `-p cipherbox-fuse --features fuse`.
Dead-code warnings in `fuse_abi.rs` are pre-existing from the vendored `fuser` ABI file — not caused by phase changes.
The rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' diagnostic on `fuse/windows/mod.rs` is expected on macOS because the file is `cfg`-excluded.
Plan 45-02 discovered a third duplicate of the journal-dir helper in `fuse/windows/mod.rs` that was absent from the original research scope (only 2 instances were identified).
Waves 2–5 all serialize on `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making parallel worktree execution unsuitable despite the worktree infrastructure being available.
The GSD API-surface intel tool does not support Rust — returned 0 symbols and was skipped when passing context to the planner.
`.planning/config.json` has `auto_advance: true`, which chains plan-phase directly into execute-phase without an explicit user command.

code.finding: Central file touched by every serial refactor wave (Waves 2–5); all serialized because of this shared dependency.
Target of Wave 3 (plan 45-04): replace the `"not found"` substring match with a typed `IpnsResolveOutcome` enum.
Had a third duplicate of the journal-dir helper beyond the two instances identified during research; fixed as part of 45-02.

workflow: The GSD commit helper can return a false-negative `commit_failed` status when lint-staged logs normal output to stderr; always verify via `git log` before treating a commit as failed.
VALIDATION.md template placeholders are not filled automatically — they trigger a non-blocking verification warning if left as-is after plan creation.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` headings require a `(RESOLVED)` suffix post-planning or the plan checker emits a warning.
Worktree parallelism is only beneficial when multiple plans have non-overlapping file sets; when waves are single-plan serial chains the worktree merge overhead is pure cost.
Pattern mapper (`gsd-pattern-mapper`) produces `PATTERNS.md` with analog files for new modules, giving the planner concrete style references — useful for new Rust helpers.
The security gate (ASVS L1) requires a `<threat_model>` block in every PLAN.md; the planner must be informed of this at spawn time.

friction: Git commit helper emitted false-negative `commit_failed` (lint-staged stdout routed to the error path); required a manual `git log` verification step to confirm the commit landed.
The intel/API-surface extractor has no Rust support, silently returning 0 symbols — the skip was correct but the tool gave no explicit 'unsupported language' signal.
VALIDATION.md was created with template placeholders that had to be back-filled after verification flagged them as warnings rather than being populated during initial write.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` heading needed a post-hoc `(RESOLVED)` edit — a two-step artifact that could be auto-closed by the planner instead.

Wave 3 (plan 45-04): Typed `IpnsResolveOutcome` replacing the `"not found"` substring match — not yet started.
Wave 4 (plan 45-05): Reuse `publish_file_metadata` in replay + memoize `resolve_folder_key` — not yet started.
Wave 5 (plan 45-06): Consolidate fuser/winfsp journal builders into `journal_helpers.rs` — not yet started.
Phase 45 verification and completion gates pending — only triggered after all 6 plans are done.
